mechanism: Both drugs increase serum potassium through different mechanisms (spironolactone via aldosterone antagonism, irbesartan via angiotensin II blockade), creating significant hyperkalemia risk, particularly in patients with renal impairment or diabetes.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function regularly; consider alternative agents or dose adjustment if potassium exceeds 5.5 mEq/L; educate patient on dietary potassium restriction.
